metadata.title: CodeCentra | Agent-first software development, backend and DevOps
metadata.description: We bring agentic workflows to your team and build backend, Kubernetes and DevOps that work in production. Agentic development with tests and evals as gates.
metadata.ogDescription: Agentic development for teams. We also build backend, Kubernetes and DevOps that work in production.

hero.title: Agent-first software development
hero.subtitle: We bring agentic workflows to your team. We also build the backend, Kubernetes and DevOps setup that keeps it running.

services.title: What we do
services.subtitle: From the first agent pilot to running in Kubernetes.

agentWorkflow.name: Agent-first in your environment
agentWorkflow.description: We set up coding agents in your repos with rules in the repo, CI gates and review. Your team stays in control of every change.

softwareFactory.name: Software factory
softwareFactory.description: Pipelines where agents write the code. Tests and evals act as gates, and people own the architecture.

aiProduct.name: AI in your product
aiProduct.description: We build agents and RAG into your product. Evals measure quality, and prompt injection defenses are there from the start.

legacy.name: Legacy modernization
legacy.description: Agents rewrite old code in small steps. Tests show that everything still works as before.

training.name: Training and coaching
training.description: We teach your team to work agent-first. Workshops, pair programming and support in your own repos.

classic.name: Backend, Kubernetes and DevOps
classic.description: The classic work: .NET backends, Linux, Kubernetes and CI/CD you can rely on in production.

howWeWork.title: How we work
howWeWork.subtitle: We start small, measure, and scale up only when it works.

map.title: Map
map.description: We review your repo, pipeline and risks. Then we pick where a pilot helps most.

pilot.title: Pilot
pilot.description: One repo gets agents, rules and gates. The team works on real tasks.

measure.title: Measure
measure.description: Tests, evals and lead time show what got better. We adjust what falls short.

scale.title: Scale out
scale.description: The workflow spreads to more repos. Your team takes over and owns it.

expertise.title: Our expertise
expertise.subtitle: Agents do their best work on a solid foundation. We build that too.

backend.title: Backend development
backend.description: Scalable APIs and services in .NET, Node.js and Python, with databases that handle real load.

ai.title: AI engineering
ai.description: Agents, RAG and evals you can measure. We connect models to your systems through MCP.

microservices.title: Microservices
microservices.description: We break monoliths into services that are easy to maintain and scale.

cloud.title: Cloud infrastructure
cloud.description: We deploy and run cloud-native systems on the major cloud providers.

integration.title: System integration
integration.description: We connect your systems so data gets where it needs to go.

monitoring.title: Monitoring and observability
monitoring.description: Logging, metrics and alerts that show problems before your users notice them.

products.title: Our products
products.subtitle: We build our own products the same way we help clients. Both are built agent-first by us.

saaty.name: Saaty
saaty.description: Booking platform with AI agents that help customers book and get answers to their questions.

kraftsmedjan.name: Kraftsmedjan
kraftsmedjan.description: Training platform for electrical power and automation, with an AI tutor that answers questions during the course.

contact.title: Let's work together
contact.subtitle: Want to get started with agents, or need help with backend and operations? Send us an email.

footer.description: Agent-first software development, backend and DevOps. A Swedish consultancy that also builds its own products.
